title: Fix admin panel access/loading for owner account and show locked Owner email in admin UI

requirements.text: Fix the admin route infinite loading state by handling the case where the authenticated user is signed in but the backend actor is not available (or admin check cannot run). Update the admin-gating UI to show a clear error state with a retry action instead of spinning forever.

quotes: Im logged in to traviscastonguay@gmail.com and it wont let me in the panel and it wont load fix it

acceptanceCriteria: When a user is authenticated and the backend actor is unavailable after initialization, the /admin route shows an error message in English (not an infinite loading spinner).
The error state provides a visible Retry action that re-attempts initializing the actor/admin check (or instructs the user to refresh) and does not require a full hard reload to re-attempt.
When the backend actor becomes available, the admin check proceeds and the gate transitions out of the error/loading state appropriately.
No changes are made to immutable frontend paths listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT.

requirements.text: Ensure the owner account associated with the email "traviscastonguay@gmail.com" can successfully gain admin access so the admin panel loads. Implement a backend owner bootstrap mechanism that can grant admin privileges to the principal that proves ownership by having a saved user profile email matching "traviscastonguay@gmail.com".

quotes: Im logged in to traviscastonguay@gmail.com and it wont let me in the panel and it wont load fix it

acceptanceCriteria: Backend exposes a safe, explicit method that allows the caller to attempt to claim owner/admin status when their stored UserProfile.email equals "traviscastonguay@gmail.com".
Once claimed, subsequent calls to the existing admin check used by the frontend (actor.isCallerAdmin()) return true for the owner principal and do not trap.
Owner/admin status persists across canister upgrades (use stable storage and add backend/migration.mo only if required by existing state upgrade policy).
If a non-matching email attempts to claim owner/admin, the call fails with a clear error (trap message) and does not change admin state.
Add an audit log entry when owner/admin is successfully claimed.

requirements.text: Add an Owner indicator in the admin UI that displays the email "traviscastonguay@gmail.com" with a lock icon and the label "Owner", and ensure it cannot be edited from the UI.

quotes: also make sure in admin put traviscastonguay@gmail.com but put a lock over it and say owner  so it cant be edited

acceptanceCriteria: In the admin panel UI, there is a clearly visible row/card showing "traviscastonguay@gmail.com" with a lock icon and the text label "Owner".
The Owner email is rendered read-only: there are no edit inputs, no remove button, and no UI affordance that suggests it is editable.
All user-facing text is in English.
The Owner indicator renders consistently with existing admin styling (Tailwind/shadcn components), without modifying read-only UI component sources under frontend/src/components/ui.

constraints: Backend must remain a single-actor Motoko canister with logic in backend/main.mo.
Only generate backend/migration.mo if needed for upgrading existing stable state (conditional migration policy).
Do not edit immutable frontend paths listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT (compose around them instead).
Use English for any user-facing text.
nonGoals: Implementing general email-based admin management for arbitrary emails (the current hooks are stubbed and backend does not support it).
Adding third-party authentication providers or exposing real user email from Internet Identity (not available on IC).
